meaning:
κατα-γελάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Job.5:22, Pro.29:9, al. ;]
to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), Mat.9:24, Mrk.5:40, Luk.8:53.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was…
They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.
